name: NGP-ERGAS
aliases: Instant Neural Graphics Primitives with ERGAS
definition: A variant of Instant-NGP that modifies the training loop to compute the Relative Dimensionless Global Error (ERGAS) loss on a custom thread block of rays, rather than per-pixel, to improve fine detail reconstruction.
summary: NGP-ERGAS is a regularization strategy for Instant-NGP that improves fine detail reconstruction by grouping GPU threads to compute global structural error, enabling nonlocal loss calculation within tile-independent parallel architectures.
